# VisualTimmy

> VisualTimmy is a curated digital art asset store specializing in premium Procreate brushes, textures, and creative tools for digital artists.

Founded by digital artist Timmy Mattaliano, VisualTimmy offers 1400+ creative assets including brush sets, texture packs, and color palettes designed specifically for Procreate on iPad. The store has earned a 4.9-star average rating from 1000+ customers and provides instant downloads for commercial and personal use.
